open: No 7-Eleven or staffed ticket office (DSB lists none; 7-Eleven list has no Middelfart store).
Toilets: DSB says locked because of vandalism; OSM hours are probably stale.
Shops (City Kiosk, KudosGames Café, Bennike el) are 'in station building' per OSM only; their own sites not checked.
No published station plan (DSB, Banedanmark, Midttrafik/FynBus/NT) found on 2026-10-30; DSB publishes access only as present/absent lines. Level heights: no source measures them.

answers.question: OSM extract has no platform ways; lifts are not linked to perron 1 (spor 1/3) or 2 (spor 4). Whether the lifts reach the platforms or the street on the far side is unsettled.
answers.answer: Lifts serve perron 1 (spor 1/3), perron 2 (spor 4) (Both lifts (-1;0) lie inside the platform outlines (OSM r11605662 ref 1 and r15870987 ref 2) between the register lines. They reach the platforms from the underpass, not the street on the far side. Source is OSM only.)
